 Chemung County hosts Medicare Open Enrollment event 
 By Cali Johnson Published : Oct. 20, 2026 at 1:25 PM EDT | Updated : 2 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google CHEMUNG COUNTY, N.Y. (WBNG) — The Chemung County Department of Aging is hosting a Medicare Open Enrollment Event. 
 The tabling is taking place Tuesday, Oct. 20, until 3 p.m. at New Beginnings United Methodist Church, 300 East Miller Street in Elmira.
 The event gives residents a chance to review their current Medicare coverage, learn about available plan options and prepare for potential changes in benefits and costs for 2027. 
 Officials say looking over existing plans is an important step in ensuring that beneficiaries have coverage that continues to meet healthcare needs, especially those considering changes to their 2027 coverage.
 Local insurance agents and brokers are also available throughout the event to discuss Medicare plan offerings and answer questions.
 A representative from the New York State Elderly Pharmaceutical Insurance Coverage (EPIC) program is available to provide information about prescription drug assistance for eligible New Yorkers.
 For additional information, contact the Chemung County Department of Aging at 607-737-5520.
